proposals.issue_title: Brittle Image Generation Fallback & Lack of Quality Gates
proposals.current_pain_description: Currently, if a primary image API (like Together AI) fails or hits a rate limit, the system either crashes or silently falls back to Pollinations, which generates low-quality, unusable images. These bad images waste GitHub Actions runtime and require manual deletion by Hugo.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a centralized 'image_generator_gateway.py' wrapper. It should implement a strict fallback sequence (Cloudflare -> Together AI -> Runware PAYG -> Pollinations). If Pollinations is triggered, the script must automatically flag the output metadata as 'UNVERIFIED_LOW_QUALITY' and prevent it from being packaged for publication without Hugo's manual approval.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 100% of wasted packaging/publishing time on low-quality assets; ensures only sellable assets reach final directories.

proposals.issue_title: No Automated Visual Quality Audit (Anatomy & Text Gibberish)
proposals.current_pain_description: AI models (especially FLUX-schnell and SDXL) occasionally generate deformed hands, overlapping lines, or gibberish text. Publishing these on Amazon KDP or Redbubble ruins store reputation and leads to account suspensions.
proposals.proposed_fix: Leverage the free tier of Gemini 2.5 Flash's multimodal vision capability inside 'agent_gemini_quality_check.py'. After image generation, send the low-res preview of the image to Gemini with a strict structured prompt to grade: 1) Text legibility, 2) Anatomical/structural anomalies, 3) Line cleanlines (for coloring books). If score < 7/10, automatically discard and retry generation once with an altered seed.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates 90% of visually defective products before they are shown to customers, protecting seller accounts.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Actions Artifact Expiration & Mobile Retrieval Bottleneck
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions artifacts expire after 90 days. Downloading large zip files on an Android phone via Termux is slow, hard to organize, and easy to lose track of, resulting in lost work.
proposals.proposed_fix: Set up a free Cloudflare R2 bucket (10GB free tier, $0/month) or Backblaze B2. Integrate an 'upload_to_storage.py' script at the end of every successful pipeline run. The script uploads the final product (PDF, PNG, SVG) and appends a direct download URL to a simple markdown index file ('portfolio.md') in the repo, allowing Hugo to download assets directly to his phone via a standard browser.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents data loss, organizes assets automatically, and makes mobile downloading 5x faster.

proposals.issue_title: Hardcoded LLM Models Across Multiple Agent Scripts
proposals.current_pain_description: LLM model names (e.g., 'gemini-2.5-flash') and API keys are hardcoded or independently configured across 40+ different agent scripts. When Google updates/deprecates a model, or if Hugo needs to swap to another free provider, dozens of files must be edited manually.
proposals.proposed_fix: Refactor all agents to import their LLM client and model configurations from a single shared utility module: 'src/utils/llm_client.py'. This module will handle model versioning, API key rotation, system instructions, and universal retry logic (exponential backoff for HTTP 429).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces maintenance overhead from hours to minutes when API endpoints change; prevents silent workflow failures due to model deprecation.

proposals.current_pain_description: A design generated for a t-shirt (Merch) stays in the merch folder. It is not automatically repackaged as a coloring book page, a sticker for Redbubble, a KDP low-content cover, or a digital SVG cut file, missing out on massive leverage.
proposals.proposed_fix: Introduce 'pipeline_cross_pollinator.py'. Once an asset is marked as 'high-quality approved', this script runs automated ImageMagick / potrace CLI commands (available in GitHub Actions runner) to: 1) Convert color designs to SVG vectors, 2) Extract high-contrast outlines for coloring books, 3) Resize and pad to standard KDP cover dimensions.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies the output catalog by 3x to 4x for every hour Hugo works, maximizing ROI per design.

proposals.issue_title: API Quota Exhaustion & Lack of Cross-Workflow Rate Limiting
affected_pipelines: All pipelines running on GitHub Actions cron
proposals.current_pain_description: If multiple GitHub Actions workflows trigger at once, they can collectively exceed Cloudflare's 10k daily neuron limit or Gemini's RPM limits, causing cascade failures mid-run and wasting action runner minutes.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a lightweight state-locking mechanism using a file in the repository (e.g., '.api_lock'). When a workflow starts, it checks if a lock exists or if the daily quota is nearing depletion. It can sleep or defer execution. Alternatively, serialize all production runs through a single queue manager workflow ('agent_cdc_queue_manager.py') instead of independent cron triggers.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates API rate limit failures, ensuring 100% successful completion of scheduled runs.
